title: Sonnen Gesundheitszentrum GmbH
description: sogz.de Sonnen-Gesundheitszentrum GmbH is a growing network of over 36 medical care centers MVZ across Munich and Bavaria, Germany, founded in 2013 by hematologists Dr Harald Krebs and Dr Michael Schleef. Now wholly owned by St Vinzenz Klinik Pfronten SE and run by managing directors Krebs, Schleef, Elias Maier, Antje Bräunling and Marcus Geier, it employs 125 staff with 27.4 million euro revenue and 10 million euro profit in 2023. Its specialty is hemostaseology blood clotting disorders with an in house lab, plus rheumatology, transfusion medicine, endocrinology and lipidology. The model keeps local practices in place while the central office handles IT, HR, accounting and labs. In November 2026 the practice was hit by a cyberattack, forcing paper prescriptions and limited appointments while police and IT forensics investigate.
